parts.problem_md:
Heart disease is caused by the blockage of arteries in the heart. Less oxygen is transported to the heart muscle, which causes damage to the heart.

(i) State the name of these blocked arteries.

[1]

(ii) State the name of the component of blood that transports oxygen.

[1]
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> - (i) Coronary (arteries) **[1 mark]**
> - (ii) Red blood cell(s) **[1 mark]**

> **[exam-tip]**
> Coronary heart disease specifically involves the coronary arteries that supply the heart muscle itself with blood, not the main arteries carrying blood around the rest of the body.

parts.problem_md:
The heart is the organ that pumps blood around the body.

(i) State the name of an upper chamber of the heart.

[1]

(ii) State the type of blood vessel that transports blood to the heart.

[1]

(iii) State the function of red blood cells.

[1]
parts.solution_md:
> **[mark-scheme]**
> - (i) Atrium (right or left) **[1 mark]**
> - (ii) Vein(s) **[1 mark]**
> - (iii) Transport of oxygen **[1 mark]**
> 
> Accept atria

> **[exam-tip]**
> Blood always flows into the heart through the atria (upper chambers) and out through the ventricles (lower chambers) — keep this in-through-the-top rule in mind for any heart-chamber question.

parts.problem_md:
Which factors could a person change to reduce their risk of developing coronary heart disease?

1. diet and exercise
2. stress and smoking
3. genetic predisposition and age
parts.solution_md:
**Final answer:** **The correct answer is B**

- Diet, exercise, stress and smoking are all lifestyle factors that a person can change to reduce their risk of coronary heart disease
- Genetic predisposition and age cannot be changed

**A** is incorrect because stress and smoking (statement 2) are also changeable factors

**C** is incorrect because genetic predisposition and age (statement 3) cannot be changed

**D** is incorrect because genetic predisposition and age (statement 3) cannot be changed

parts.problem_md: What is **not** used to monitor the activity of the heart?
parts.solution_md:
**Final answer:** **The correct answer is B**

- Diet and exercise are lifestyle factors that affect heart health, not tools used to monitor heart activity

**A** is incorrect because an ECG is used to monitor the electrical activity of the heart

**C** is incorrect because pulse rate is used to monitor heart rate

**D** is incorrect because the sound of heart valves is used to monitor heart activity

choices.label: D
choices.text_md: the sound of the heart valves
